observations: Photo 0 shows a car engine bay/engine assembly on a stand or floor, with intake piping and wiring harness visible.
No readable brand/model plate, engine code, or VIN/part number is visible in the photo.
No clear mileage/odometer, compression test sheet, or leak test result is shown.

claims.evidence: No guarantee document or written warranty terms visible in photo 0.
No shipping/origin paperwork visible in photo 0.

claims.claim: Tested and working, no knock, low mileage, never opened.
claims.evidence: Photo 0 does not show any test results (video of running, sound recording, compression/leak test) or mileage/engine history.

risks.risk: Engine identification mismatch (wrong engine code/variant for the buyer’s car). Photo 0 doesn’t show readable engine code/plate.
risks.proof: Ask for a clear close-up photo of the engine code/label (e.g., stamped code on block or ID plate) and the full engine bay showing the code location.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic used engine with unknown variant (worst case for fitment).

risks.risk: Condition not proven (no knock / working). Photo 0 cannot confirm internal health.
risks.proof: Ask for a short video clip of the engine running from cold start (or at least start + idle) with sound, plus a compression test or mechanic test sheet.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven working (worst case: treat as needing inspection/possible repairs).

risks.risk: Mileage and 'never opened' claim cannot be verified remotely.
risks.proof: Ask for photos of the cylinder head cover/valve cover area and any tamper marks/seals, plus a service history or inspection report.
risks.if_unproven: Price as unknown mileage/unknown prior opening.

risks.risk: Completeness risk (missing parts like alternator, starter, sensors, ECU, mounts). Photo 0 may not show everything included.
risks.proof: Ask for a checklist photo: what exactly is included (starter, alternator, alternator bracket, sensors, ECU/ignition coils, engine mounts, hoses) laid out or clearly shown.
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete/unknown inclusions (worst case: buyer may need to source missing parts).

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the engine code/ID plate stamped on the block (and where it is located).
Video of the engine running (start + idle) showing sound (no knock claim).
Compression/leak test results or a mechanic test sheet.
Photos showing what parts are included (starter, alternator, sensors, ECU/ignition components, mounts) and what is not.
response.reason: The photo shows an engine assembly but the engine code/variant and proof of running condition are not readable/visible, so a worst-case price cannot be matched confidently to the correct comparable.
